name: Ray of Frost

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Ranged spell attack Cold dice; reduce target Speed by 10 feet through start of caster next turn; cantrip scaling; independent source-owned magnitude.

rules.text: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range.
Make a ranged spell attack against the target.
On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).
